verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਚਰਮ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦਿਬਿ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਹੁਇ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਲੋਚਨ ਅਛਤ ਅੰਧ ਕੰਧ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmat charam dhirasaT dhib dhirasaT hui dhuramat lochan achhat a(n)dh ka(n)dh hai ||

en.bdb: Accepting the initiation sermon of the True Guru turns the outward vision of a person into divine vision. But the base wisdom makes a person blind despite the presence of eyes. Such a person is bereft of knowledge.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਕੈ ਬਜਰ ਕਪਾਟ ਖੁਲੈ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਕਠਿਨ ਕਪਾਟ ਸਨਬੰਧ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmat surat kai bajar kapaaT khulai dhuramat kaThin kapaaT sanaba(n)dh hai ||

en.bdb: With the sermon of the True Guru, the tight shut doors of the consciousness become ajar whereas this does not happen in the case of a person of base wisdom and self will.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਰਸ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੁਰਬਚਨ ਦੁਰਗੰਧ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gurmat prem ras a(n)mirat nidhaan paan dhuramat mukh dhurabachan dhuraga(n)dh hai ||

en.bdb: By adopting the counsel of the True Guru, one relishes the elixir of God's love perpetually. But base wisdom emanates foul smell from the mouth as a result of ill and bad words spoken.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਨ ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਬਿਗ੍ਰਹ ਬਿਰੋਧ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਸੰਧਿ ਹੈ ॥੧੭੬॥
verses.translit_en: gurmat sahaj subhai na harakh sog dhuramat bigreh birodh krodh sa(n)dh hai ||176||

en.bdb: Adopting the wisdom of True Guru produces true love and peace. He is never touched by happiness or sorrow in this state. However, base wisdom remains a cause of discord, quarrels and distress. (176)
